title: Sesquiterpenoids From Marmoritis complanata (Dunn) A. L. Budantzev With Antioxidant Activity in Zebrafish.
authors: Wang, Yongjie; Liu, Ruifeng; Wang, Xinyue; Wu, Peilin; Li, Ye; Zheng, Lin; Zhang, Jiaozhen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物倍半萜的抗氧化活性及Nrf2通路调控，仅涉及小分子与Keap1蛋白的共价对接，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: Marmoritis complanata (Dunn) A. L. Budantzev, a Tibetan medicinal plant endemic to alpine regions, is traditionally used for its anti-inflammatory properties. A novel sesquiterpenoid, marmoritiolide (1), featuring a novel 14-nor-5, 6-seco-eudesmane-type carbon skeleton with an isopropyl migration from C-7 to C-8, was isolated together with four known sesquiterpenoids (2-5). The structure of 1 was determined by HRESIMS and 1D/2D NMR. A plausible biogenetic pathway is proposed. In an H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative stress zebrafish model, compound 1 dose-dependently (12.5-50 microM) reduced intracellular ROS levels, achieving 36.9% inhibition at 50 microM (vs. the model group), comparable to the positive control (38.2%). Superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity was restored from 58.0% (model) to 82.8% of control levels at 50 microM. qPCR analysis showed that 1 upregulated the mRNA expression of Nrf2 (1.3-fold), Mn-SOD (1.6-fold), Cu/Zn-SOD (2.6-fold), and NQO1 (2.1-fold) at 50 microM. suggesting modulation of the Nrf2 pathway. Covalent docking further indicated that compound 1 can covalently modify Keap1 at Cys151, providing a mechanistic basis for Nrf2 activation. These findings highlight M. complanata as a source of structurally unique sesquiterpenoids with potent antioxidant activity.
abstract_zh: Marmoritis complanata (Dunn) A. L. Budantzev，一种高山地区特有的藏药植物，传统上用于其抗炎特性。一种新型倍半萜类化合物marmoritiolide (1)，具有新颖的14-nor-5, 6-seco-eudesmane型碳骨架，且异丙基从C-7迁移至C-8，与四种已知倍半萜类化合物 (2-5) 一同被分离。化合物1的结构通过HRESIMS和1D/2D NMR确定。提出了一个合理的生物合成途径。在H(2)O(2)诱导的氧化应激斑马鱼模型中，化合物1剂量依赖性地（12.5-50微摩尔）降低细胞内ROS水平，在50微摩尔时达到36.9%的抑制率（与模型组相比），与阳性对照（38.2%）相当。超氧化物歧化酶 (SOD) 活性在50微摩尔时从58.0%（模型组）恢复至对照水平的82.8%。qPCR分析显示，在50微摩尔时，1上调了Nrf2（1.3倍）、Mn-SOD（1.6倍）、Cu/Zn-SOD（2.6倍）和NQO1（2.1倍）的mRNA表达，表明其调节Nrf2通路。共价对接进一步表明，化合物1可在Cys151位点共价修饰Keap1，为Nrf2激活提供了机制基础。这些发现凸显了M. complanata作为具有强效抗氧化活性的结构独特倍半萜类化合物来源的价值。
